verdicts.reason: A keeps the framed structure, the reading order and the orange tint intact. Its main flaw is that the orange overlay no longer covers the full width: it leaves untinted photo strips on the left and right edges, which look like a mistake, and the frame doesn't fill the canvas well vertically. B is broken. The orange tint has shrunk to an empty floating rectangle, so the brand colour is lost. The frame has collapsed to a tiny stub at the bottom left beside a huge, clumsy play-arrow icon. The text order is jumbled, with 'Theatre presents' and the tickets line shuffled under the title, and the small text sits directly on a busy photo.
